name: toolchain
command:
test -z "$(gofmt -l $(git ls-files "*.go"))"
go mod verify
go build -p 2 ./...
go vet -p 2 ./...
python3 docs/check-strong-crypto-compose.py

name: web
command:
npm audit --prefix web --omit=dev --audit-level=low
npm run build --prefix web
git diff --exit-code -- web/dist
npm test --prefix web

name: workers
command:
npm ci --prefix workers/apns
npm audit --prefix workers/apns --omit=dev --audit-level=low
npm run typecheck --prefix workers/apns
npm ci --prefix workers/fcn
npm audit --prefix workers/fcn --omit=dev --audit-level=low
npm run typecheck --prefix workers/fcn
node --test push-relay-shared/*.test.mts workers/apns/src/*.test.mts workers/fcn/src/*.test.mts

name: repeatable
command:
mkdir -p "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/a/src"
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/a/src"
(cd "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/a/src" && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -p 2 -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/Busnes-app/kyidentity-server/internal/appversion.release=0.0.0" -o "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/a/kyidentity" ./cmd/kyidentity)
mkdir -p "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/elsewhere/b/src"
git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/elsewhere/b/src"
(cd "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/elsewhere/b/src" && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -p 2 -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w -X github.com/Busnes-app/kyidentity-server/internal/appversion.release=0.0.0" -o "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/elsewhere/b/kyidentity" ./cmd/kyidentity)
sha256sum "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/a/kyidentity" "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/elsewhere/b/kyidentity"
cmp "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/a/kyidentity" "/tmp/kyidentity-repeatable-d667jgjc/elsewhere/b/kyidentity"

name: docker
command:
docker build -t kyidentity-ui-r2:2063542 .
 container_id=$(docker run -d -e PUSH_RELAY_URL= -e APNS_RELAY_URL= kyidentity-ui-r2:2063542)
 trap 'docker rm -f "$container_id" >/dev/null' EXIT
 ready=0
 for attempt in $(seq 1 30); do
  if docker exec "$container_id" wget -q --spider http://localhost:5867/readyz; then ready=1; break; fi
  sleep 1
 done
 test "$ready" = 1
 if docker run --rm -e KYIDENTITY_ISSUER_URL=http://auth.example.test kyidentity-ui-r2:2063542; then exit 1; fi
